mapper.select: SELECT EXERCISE_ID /* 운동아이디 */ , NAME /* 운동명 */ , BODY_PART_CD , EQUIPMENT_CD , (SELECT DTL_CD_NM FROM CMM_CODE_DTL WHERE COM_CD_ID = 'BODY_PART_CD' AND DTL_CD_ID = E.BODY_PART_CD) AS BODY_PART_NM /* 대표부위코드 */ , (SELECT DTL_CD_NM FROM CMM_CODE_DTL WHERE COM_CD_ID = 'EXERCISE_EQUIPMENT_CD' AND DTL_CD_ID = E.EQUIPMENT_CD) AS EQUIPMENT_NM /* 요구장비코드 */ , IMAGE_FILE_ID /* 이미지파일아이디 */ , REG_DT /* 등록일시 */ , MOD_DT /* 변경일시 */ FROM EXERCISES WHERE EXERCISE_ID = #{exerciseId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM EXERCISES WHERE EXERCISE_ID = #{exerciseId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}
